overview: Studying Undergraduate Engineering (UG Hub) in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Which are the top universities for Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Aalto University, Tampere University, LUT University, Metropolia UAS, HAMK, and VAMK are among Finland

faq.question: Is IELTS mandatory to study Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Not always. While research universities commonly require IELTS Academic (min 6.0–6.5), many Universities of Applied Sciences evaluate English proficiency directly through the International UAS Online Joint Entrance Exam.

faq.question: Can I work in Finland during and after my Engineering degree?
faq.answer: Yes. International students can work up to 30 hours per week during term time and full-time during holidays. After graduation, students can apply for a two-year post-study residence permit to work as engineers in Finland.
